**Overview:** The 457-amino-acid sequence is an exact match to *Escherichia coli* MdtK (UniProt B7US04), a multipass inner-membrane multidrug efflux protein in the MatE transporter family. Its reviewed annotation describes it as a **probable sodium-coupled drug antiporter**, helping export diverse compounds; the specific transported substrates are not established by this sequence analysis.

It has a predicted molecular mass of about **49.4 kDa** and theoretical pI of **9.63**. Two MatE domains were detected, consistent with the transporter-family assignment. The sodium-coupled mechanism is annotated as probable, rather than demonstrated by the sequence analysis itself.
